thread:
elaine: Quick proposal — 'Model view snapshots' feature for the Console. Allow users to capture a compact snapshot of: active filters, pinned model, time window, and a small telemetry badge (sample rate + quota peek). Snapshots are lightweight and shareable from the route/model header.

jordan: I like the idea. Quick Q: is this just a UI bookmark or does it create a server-side saved query?

elaine: Good call. Two flavors: ephemeral snapshot (client-side, not counted against saved-query quota, short retention) and persistent snapshot (server-side saved query with ACLs & retention). Users can click "Promote to saved" to convert ephemeral -> persistent.

mika: From platform side we need an API flag. Suggest saved_query.scope = "ephemeral" | "persistent" and ephemeral entries set a short TTL and soft-visibility (not in team listing unless promoted). Also we should audit-promote events.

frank: Telemetry needs: when showing a snapshot we should surface sample_rate, representative token-cost-per-call, and route consumption percent (last 24h). If ephemeral snapshots are client-only we still need a backend endpoint to compute the telemetry badge (because sampling & cost calc are heavy).

jordan: UX notes: place a small camera icon next to route/model title. Clicking shows a flyout with a compact preview + "Open" "Share" "Promote" actions. Promote should trigger a tiny modal to pick owner/team and visibility.

elaine: Proposed API contract sketch for persistent saved queries (backend):
```json
{
  "id": "sq_123",
  "name": "string",
  "owner": "team:abc",
  "scope": "persistent", // ephemeral for snapshots
  "filters": [ {"field":"route","op":"eq","value":"/chat"} ],
  "pinned_model": "redwood/gpt-small:2026-02",
  "time_window": "P1D",
  "telemetry_snapshot": {"sample_rate":"0.01","avg_tokens":120}
}
```

mika: That shape works. Two asks: 1) ephemeral snapshots should not write to main saved_query table; use ephemeral_cache with TTL and light index. 2) Promotion endpoint should atomically materialize persistent record and decrement ephemeral counts for quota.

frank: For telemetry_snapshot we should store the config used to compute it (sample windows + metric subset) so UI badges are reproducible. Also we should tag telemetry with model-version for correct cost estimate.

jordan: One more UX edge: if a snapshot references a model that's been rolled out/retired, show a small warning and a suggested replacement list (compatible variants).

elaine: Action items:
- mika: design ephemeral_cache + promote endpoint (TODO: include TTL policy and retention tiers).
- jordan: mock flyout + promote modal, flows for retired model warning.
- frank: telemetry badge contract and which metrics to surface.
- I'll draft a short rollout plan (feature-flagged canary, metrics to watch: promote rate, saved-query quota bump, telemetry compute latency).

mika: I'll slot the API work for next sprint. Also we need a small pricing/quotas decision: do promotions count as creating a saved query under the team's quota? My vote: yes, promotion consumes a saved-query slot.

elaine: Agreed — promotions count. We'll surface a small affordance in the modal: "Promote will use 1 saved-query slot from Team X".

ops-bot: deploy: PR #2317 created for ephemeral_cache prototype — https://git.redwood/pr/2317 :construction:

jordan: rough mock uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/snapshots/model-view-snap (DM for access)

frank: one more ask — add a telemetry column to saved-query listing: "last badge refresh" so we know stale snapshots.

elaine: noted. plan: ship behind feature flag to 10% of orgs next week, monitor promote conversion and telemetry latency. If metrics look good, broaden rollout.

mika: +1 :thumbsup:

jordan: :eyes: I'll sync with design ops and attach mock updates to the PR.

elaine: thanks all — leaving next steps in the product board. Ping me if you want to be on the beta list.
